definitions.confidenceSelection: Largest reported ipTM; lowest seed breaks ties. No crystal, validity or clash filtering before ranking. Missing or nonfinite confidence suppresses confidence-based rates for that budget.
definitions.oracle: Any hit within the fixed seed prefix uses the experimental answer and is a retrospective best-of-N statistic.
definitions.failures: Execution failures remain in the planned denominator. A case with all executions failed is a miss for both selections.
definitions.partial: Observed counts may increase. Rates are emitted only once every planned prediction in the group and seed prefix is terminal.
definitions.scope: Native-positive reconstruction cohort; related sequences and clusters remain present. Descriptive counts, not population accuracy or implementation parity.
definitions.validity: Limited stereochemical-identity and severe protein–ligand clash diagnostics, not full physical validation.

timing.definition: Recorded launcher wall time includes page/browser startup, available asset loading, folding, confidence calculation and archive checks. It excludes subsequent independent scoring and does not isolate GPU kernel time. Fresh browser profiles, caches and system conditions affect it; this single-device run is not a cross-hardware speed comparison.
